tasks.title: Persist and rebuild the graph projection in SQLite
acceptance_criteria: A transactional full rebuild persists nodes, edges, evidence, issues, and run metadata.
Deleting the database and rebuilding yields an equivalent project projection.
Foreign keys are enabled and Markdown remains unchanged.
risks: better-sqlite3 is a native module and must match the Electron ABI.

tasks.title: Verify Electron compatibility and bounded graph performance
acceptance_criteria: The native module loads in the installed Electron runtime.
A bounded 10000-node and 50000-edge persistence/query benchmark completes and reports measurements.
No Electron graph API, UI, or Graph RAG code is introduced.
risks: Electron rebuild may require a compiler toolchain if no prebuilt binary matches.
